name: Bewitched
source:
The protagonist, a boy named Thomas, has a difficult life. It gets even worse when his father marries a woman who simply can’t stand her stepson. His whole life changes with a sudden trip to his aunt, whom he visited once many years ago. Now he is definitely distracted from all sad thoughts, because his aunt Alice is a real witch who has a talking cat and a bunch of magical things, and her house is not exactly the right place for little boys. But despite of all the dangers, Thomas accepts the challenge and firmly decides to reach the heights of potion-making and to reveal all the secrets hidden behind the magical barrier.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160820/Bewitched/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个名叫托马斯的男孩，他的生活一直不太顺遂。父亲再婚后，日子变得更加难过，因为继母根本容不下这个继子。一次突然的旅行，让他前去拜访多年前只见过一次的姑妈，也彻底改变了他的人生。现在，他终于顾不上那些伤心事了——姑妈爱丽丝竟是一位真正的女巫，养着一只会说话的猫，还拥有许多魔法物品，而她的家显然不太适合小男孩居住。尽管危险重重，托马斯仍然接受了挑战，决心在魔药制作上登峰造极，并揭开魔法屏障背后隐藏的一切秘密。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160820/Bewitched/]Steam[/url]]
